\[

\]

where \( R \) is the Rydberg constant (\( R \approx 1.097 \times 10^7 \, \text{m}^{-1} \)), \( n_1 = 2 \), and \( n_2 = 4 \).

Let's calculate this:

\[
\frac{1}{\lambda} = 1.097 \times 10^7 \left( \frac{1}{2^2} - \frac{1}{4^2} \right) = 1.097 \times 10^7 \left( \frac{1}{4} - \frac{1}{16} \right) = 1.097 \times 10^7 \left( \frac{4 - 1}{16} \right) = 1.097 \times 10^7 \left( \frac{3}{16} \right)
\]

\[
\frac{1}{\lambda} = 1.097 \times 10^7 \times \frac{3}{16} = 2.058 \times 10^6 \, \text{m}^{-1}
